subject: music
title: Voice Types
welcome_lead: Soprano, alto, tenor, bass — the singing family.
meta_desc: KS3 voice: SATB voice types and choir parts.
final_note: Knowing voice types lets you sort a choir.

walkthroughs.body_html: The four standard voices are Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass — SATB. Choirs are written in 4 parts, one per voice.
Boys' voices typically drop around age 12-14 (puberty). A boy soprano (treble) may become a tenor or bass. Some keep a high countertenor range.
A cappella singing has no instruments — voices only. Groups like Pentatonix make whole bands sounds from voices alone.
